description:
Designer & management software for xTool laser cutters & engravers.


General
1. Connectivity Improvements: Reworked the repair logic and user experience to resolve device discovery and connection issues more effectively.
2. Improved Onboarding: Follow a guided setup for your new device from app launch through your first processing job. This release supports P2S, P3, F1 Ultra, and the F2 Series.

Editor
1. Project File Previews: View cover thumbnails for .xs project files in local folders to find the right project at a glance.
2. Assembly Structure Detection and Alerts: Studio checks for potential assembly issues when you import or resize an assembly design or apply a material thickness in the editor, so you can adjust the design before processing.
3. Overlapping Element Detection: Quickly find and select partially overlapping paths, then remove unwanted elements as needed.
4. Dashed Lines: Apply dashed strokes to outlines or create dashed cutting paths for tear-off lines and folds.
5. Rasterize / Merge: Use Rasterize to convert vector graphics, text, images, or combinations of these elements into a single image and merge all currently visible effects. Use Merge to combine multiple images into one and flatten all image effects.
6. Image Replacement: Replace an existing image with an imported image, an image from the asset library or My Space, or another image on the canvas.
7. Crop to Edges: Crop images with transparent edges to the smallest rectangle that encloses the image content in one click.
8. Batch Import from My Space: Import multiple files at once from My Space in the editor sidebar.
9. Improved Smart Nesting: All nesting modes now support Unified Object Size, so you can resize multiple objects to the same dimensions before arranging them.
10. Customizable Box Selection: Choose your preferred box selection mode in the editor settings.
11. Split Print-and-Cut Objects: Split a group of print-and-cut objects into individual objects you can edit separately.
12. Improved 3D Photo: Improved point cloud generation. Adjust point spacing, image processing mode, and inversion on the results page, and switch between the original and simplified models on the canvas.

Material Settings
1. Processing Module and Laser Source Recommendations: Studio recommends a module or laser source based on the material and processing type. If the current module or source is not recommended, you can confirm the switch manually.
2. Improved Material Selection: Official material profiles now indicate which processing types are not recommended for each module or laser source, helping reduce processing failures.

xTool O1 Omni Printer
1. Smart Mask: Batch-fill multiple similar shapes with a design in one click.
2. Processing Statistics: View ink usage and costs for processing jobs by day, week, or month, and export reports as PDF or Excel files.
3. Grayscale Ink Output: In UV printing, white ink, varnish, and fluorescent ink can follow image brightness to create gradients.
4. Ink Density: Adjust white ink, varnish, and fluorescent ink density independently in UV printing.
5. Improved Translucent Effects: Studio adjusts white ink and varnish output based on bitmap transparency for smoother transitions along translucent edges.
6. High-Gap Printing Risk Detection: Check material height differences before printing. Follow the risk alert to enable high-gap printing or adjust the material.
7. Full-Wrap Printing: Set left and right print extensions independently when using the rotary attachment to improve edge coverage.

xTool X1
1. Fiber, MOPA, and UV lasers now support vertical laser emission for vector fill and bitmap engraving.
2. Added focus lift settings for color engraving.
3. Added galvo laser on/off delay and fill gap compensation settings.
4. The material test array supports more parameters.
5. Relief engraving now supports framing.
6. Improved 20W blue laser autofocus with external light detection.
7. Added a height compensation reminder for large bitmap jobs.
8. Improved distance measurement guidance to help you choose a suitable measurement point.
9. Improved the Smart Optimize workflow with material selection guidance.

xTool C1
1. Transparent Material Color: Choose Transparent as the material color to display cut objects as outlines for easier alignment.
2. Expanded Image Processing: Cut directly along image outlines, or use images for pen drawing, hot foiling, and scoring transfer.

Bug Fixes
1. Fixed an issue where changes to the C1 Hot Foil Pen line width were not applied during processing.
2. Fixed an issue where the C1 Rotary Blade sometimes failed to cut all the way through the material.
3. Fixed issues that could cause C1 device initialization or machine accuracy calibration to fail.
4. Improved the display of the 12 in × 12 ft canvas for C1.
5. Fixed an issue where the actual dot duration was half the configured value in some cases on xTool F2 Ultra UV.
6. Fixed some known issues.
